title: Pseudo-coherence is preserved by direct summands
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let K, L, and M be objects of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. If K is isomorphic to L \oplus M and K is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], then L and M are pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Tag 08CE (pseudo-coherent complexes are closed under direct summands)

proof.text: For each point x, unpack [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex] to get an open U and a bounded-above finite-free complex P representing K there. Refine to an affine V containing x. Apply overMap termwise: map_isZero preserves the upper support bound, and sigmaComparison with overMapUnitIso preserves finite-free terms. The mapDerivedCategoryNatIso, mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactors comparisons give the representing isomorphism on V.

Use the actual affine sheafification functor F_V recorded in [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model]. Restriction along isoSpec is an equivalence, overEquiv.inverse is an equivalence, and tilde is fully faithful [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], so F_V is fully faithful. For every degree choose the explicit finite free module of the given rank; [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module] and transport of the unit identify its sheafification with P in that degree. Lift each differential by F_V.preimage, and prove the shape and square-zero equations by F_V.map_injective. These component isomorphisms give an actual complex isomorphism F_V(A) ≅ P. Full faithfulness also reflects the zero terms above the bound; A is bounded above and finite free.

Map K ≅ L ⊕ M through derived open restriction and its mapBiprod isomorphism. Combine with the model from the preceding step and apply [lem-pc-affine-derived-summand-models] to obtain a sheafification functor G, module preimages C,D of the two restrictions, and Q(A) ≅ C ⊕ D. The explicit A witnesses [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex] for C ⊕ D. Apply the final clause of [lem-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-summand] to get finite-free bounded-above models of C and D.

Sheafify each resulting model termwise using F_V. map_isZero gives the upper bound; reindex a finite chosen module basis by ULift(Fin r) and use [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module] and the affine free-module comparison for its terms. Compose the summand-preimage isomorphism with G.mapIso of the model isomorphism and the natural comparison at that complex. This is the required local witness for [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Projecting the two witnesses at each x gives the conclusion. Empty X is vacuous and zero summands require no special hypotheses.
